prompts.present_2026: Aerial drone footage flying over the historic center of Mexico City today. Dense blocks of colonial and modern buildings in red tezontle stone and pale plaster with flat rooftops and water tanks, a white Art Nouveau palace with domes, a tall glass and steel tower, narrow streets with traffic and pedestrians, and ahead the baroque Metropolitan Cathedral beside the huge open Zócalo plaza with its giant flag and the long facade of the National Palace. Clear morning light, light smog toward distant volcanic mountains, documentary cinematography, realistic, highly detailed.
prompts.past_1519: Aerial drone footage flying over Tenochtitlan in 1519, the Aztec island capital in the middle of a vast turquoise lake. Dense rows of white lime-plastered flat-roofed adobe houses with small courtyards, straight canals with wooden canoes, green chinampa gardens at the shore, and ahead a walled sacred precinct with plazas of polished stone, a round temple and a great stepped pyramid with twin red and blue shrines on top and steep stairways. A long straight causeway crosses the lake toward distant volcanic mountains. Soft morning light, light haze over the water, documentary cinematography, realistic, highly detailed.
